description: Reports an uncertain finding with its confidence stated rather than dropping it below a gate
input:
Review this change. There is no repo for you to inspect — this diff and the note below are everything available, so review what is here and say what you could not cover.
```diff
+def refund(order_id, amount):
+    order = db.get_order(order_id)
+    if order.refunded_total + amount > order.total:
+        raise ValueError("over-refund")
+    gateway.refund(order.payment_id, amount)
+    order.refunded_total += amount
+    db.save(order)
```
Note: `refund` is reachable from an HTTP handler and from a nightly reconciliation job.
rubric: PASS only if the reply reports more than one finding and every finding carries both a severity label and a numeric or explicit confidence value. The read-modify-write race on refunded_total (two concurrent callers both passing the check) must be among them. A finding the reviewer is unsure about must appear with a low confidence stated rather than be omitted. FAIL if only a single finding is reported, if any finding lacks a confidence, or if the reply says it is withholding low-confidence items.
